The parrot understands only English for now: for commands in %1$s, download %2$s in myCar\'s rigging on the phone.

The phone\'s parrot wakes as with the swipe up from a bottom corner of the phone\'s screen. Another parrot listens and answers on the phone, and its voice comes aboard only over Bluetooth; with the phone locked, it starts once the phone is unlocked - or, with Home Assistant set up in myCar, myCar listens instead and Home Assistant answers. myCar\'s own works offline, locked or not, and shows at the helm; with Home Assistant set up, what it can\'t do itself goes to Home Assistant\'s voice assistant.
Calls and shanties play over Bluetooth, but your phone isn\'t connected to the car. Connect it from the car\'s Bluetooth menu or your phone\'s.
Chart apps can\'t show where you are or give directions. Turn on location in your phone\'s quick settings when you\'re parked.
Calls and shanties play through the car\'s speakers once your phone and the car are paired. Your phone then asks you to confirm a code.
Add video sites and TV lists in myCar\'s rigging on the phone, under Cinema.
